Yes. The current evidence (version 2, as of 2026-11-12) shows that all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) covered every day from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-08. FIRMS recorded no thermal detections intersecting the property in that period.

An earlier version (version 1, as of 2026-10-08) had a gap. The last days, 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-08, were not yet covered because the near-real-time data had not been updated. Version 2 supersedes it and closes that gap.

Limits: "no detection" does not prove that no fire occurred, because small, short, cool or cloud-obscured fires may go undetected. The evidence also says nothing about burned area, the cause of any change, or dates outside the period.
